# A06 report: Browser agent and recipe learning

Branch `v2-a06-agent` (cut from `v2` at e27ba13). Everything lives in `server/agent/**`, plus one minimal change set in
`server/forms/engine.ts` (listed below), fixtures in `fixtures/ats/_a06/`, recordings in `fixtures/claude/agent_step/` and
`fixtures/claude/recipe_compile/`, the selfcheck `scripts/checks/a06-agent.ts`, and the recording oracle `scripts/a06/oracle.ts`.
No dependency added (own loop on `playwright-core`; no Stagehand).

## What was built

| File | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `agent/index.ts` | Contract surface, stub names and signatures kept: `agentFill`, `compileTrace`, `submitExternalTrace`, `learningMetrics`; plus `runRecipeJobs()` (A08), `agentIntended(page)` and `shadowFromEngine()` (A05 hooks). |
| `agent/loop.ts` | `agentFill`. **Recipe first:** an `active` recipe for the page replays deterministically (no Claude call, cost 0). Otherwise the Claude loop (`structured()`, task `agent_step`, one `AgentAction` per turn): observe (A05 `extractStep` across frames, A05 read-back, A05 mapper suggestions, own snapshot of controls and visible text), decide, act, record. Actions: fill / select / check / upload (value **keys** only, resolved by A05's recipe resolver), click (control refs), next, wait, ask_value (A05 mapper → A03 bank → A04 writer), done (self-verifies with A05 `verifyFields`; up to 3 tries), give_up. Guardrails: 60 steps max, 6-minute time limit (each turn raced against it), `signal` honoured mid-turn (throws `AbortError`), CAPTCHA → `blocked` before any Claude call, main-frame navigation guard (`page.route`) plus URL check every turn, A05 submit guard armed, never moves past a page that does not verify. Records an `agent_runs` row (status, steps, cost, injection attempts and snippets), saves the trace, shadow-checks the matching candidate, compiles the trace. Screenshots go to Claude only on live runs (`BUREAU_AGENT_VISION=0` disables), never in replay/record, so hashes stay stable. |
| `agent/guard.ts` | Domain allow-list (`policyFor`: the page, the job's URL and apply URL, their registrable domains, and the ATS family's domains, `ATS_DOMAINS`; loopback fixtures by exact host:port), `urlVerdict` (no other site, no login/sign-up/SSO path, no payment/checkout), `clickVerdict` (refuses final submit / send / apply / share-with-partners / pay / any other `type=submit` that is not a Next, login links, off-site links; flags wizard Next so the submit gate opens just for it), `detectInjection` (instruction-shaped text anywhere: visible, `display:none`, comments, placeholders, aria-labels, options). |
| `agent/page.ts` | In-page helper (plain JS like A05's): `snapshot` (headings, visible clickables stamped `data-bureau-agent="k<n>"` with role, name, href and selector candidates `#id` / data-testid / aria-label / name / `text=<role>\|<name>`), `scan` (all text incl. hidden, for injection logging only), `find` (resolve selector candidates for replay). |
| `agent/prompt.ts` | `AGENT_SYSTEM` (rules + `UNTRUSTED_NOTE`) and the turn content: value-key catalogue (keys and has=yes/no, never the values), page text, fields (with current value and the mapper's suggested key), controls, history, notes; every page-derived block `fence()`d; a `<security>` note when injection text was found. Byte-stable: no timestamps, ids or temp paths. |
| `agent/values.ts` | Value keys: `profile:<key>`, `file:cv\|letter`, `writer:coverLetter\|<short answer>`, `generated:consent:privacy\|consent:marketing\|eeo:decline`, `answer_bank:<id>`, `suggested`. Resolved through A05 `recipeValue()` (so compiled recipes resolve identically). Anything else is refused: the agent cannot type a fact. |
| `agent/trace.ts` | `TraceRecorder` (per action: signature, labelNorm, widget, selector candidates, value source/key, wizard step, URL, before/after JPEG in `DATA_DIR/agent/traces/<id>/`), `saveTrace`, `loadTrace` (re-validates rows; others' rows are untrusted), `listTraces`, `shotUrl`/`shotFile` (screenshots by URL only, strict name pattern). |
| `agent/replay.ts` | Deterministic recipe replay: clicks by selector candidates (through `clickVerdict`), fills via A05 `resolveSteps` (selectors → signature → label+widget) and `recipeValue` (mapper fallback for keys like how-heard), hooks answered fresh by the mapper/writer, page check before every Next, final verify. A `submit` step ends the replay. |
| `agent/compile.ts` | `compileTrace`: successful steps (last fill per field wins) → `candidate` recipe. Scope: known ATS → **ats scope** keyed on signatures; else company; else URL. External key conventions normalised (`firstName`→`first_name`, `resume`→`cv`). Writer answers → hooks. For ats scope, steps the synonym dictionary does not know go to Claude (`recipe_compile`) to classify generic vs company-specific (company → hook; unavailable → hook, the safe side). Equivalent existing candidate/active recipe → trace linked (`duplicate`), no new version. |
| `agent/shadow.ts` | Dry-mode comparison (`compareRecipe`: the field each step resolves to on a real run, the value the recipe would use vs the value used; ≥ 75% of steps found, zero value diffs). Results in `recipe_shadow_runs` with the diff. **3 internal matches → `active`** (A05's `setRecipeStatus` emits `recipe.promoted`); **3 internal mismatches → `demoted`** (discarded); external observations are recorded but never count. |
| `agent/jobs.ts` | `runRecipeJobs()` work queue (A08 calls it every 6 h): intake of every `agent_traces` row never queued (incl. A07's `external:%` rows from the stub period), external-trace observations against existing candidates (never votes), compile, threshold re-evaluation. Single-flight. |
| `agent/queue.ts`, `agent/schema.ts` | `agent_learning` (queue status per trace), `agent_runs`, `recipe_shadow_runs` (created idempotently on import, A05's pattern; no `db.ts` edit). |
| `agent/metrics.ts` | `learningMetrics({days})`: `daily` (agentRuns, recipeRuns = agent recipe replays + A05 recipe runs, adapterRuns, genericRuns, agent cost), `costPerRun`, `totals` (incl. promoted), `coverage` by ATS (recipes by status, ats-scope active, learned), outcomes, learning queue (internal / external), shadow stats, injection attempts. |
| `agent/routes.ts` | UI routes below (shapes match `web/src/api.ts`: `AgentMetrics`, `TraceSummary`, `TraceDetail`). |

### Changes inside `server/forms/engine.ts` (A05's file; minimal, please review)

1. **No form found → agent → engine verifies → engine submits.** `agentOrNeedsYou` now returns `null` after the agent's `done`, and the
   run continues: a new `agentStep()` re-verifies the agent's fills on the page it finished on (from `agentIntended(page)`) plus every
   required field there; the final nav must be a real submit; then the normal tail (unknown questions, CAPTCHA, verified check, rehearse /
   `submitVerified`). Before, this path always ended `needs_you`.
2. **Unverified generic run → agent:** also for `via: 'recipe'` runs that do not verify (the brief's repair item: the agent completes, its
   trace becomes a new recipe version; the failed recipe run is recorded). After `done` the agent's own page is verified too (`agentStep`),
   and `finalNav` must be `kind: 'submit'` (before, a Next button could be taken as the final nav).
3. `tryAgent` rethrows `AbortError` (the kill switch stops the run instead of turning into `needs_you`).
4. `recordRecipe` returns early for `via: 'agent'` (A06 records its own recipe runs and learns from its traces).
5. `shadowHook()` after every verified adapter / generic / recipe run: the matching candidate recipe is compared in dry mode
   (`shadowFromEngine`).

## Routes (all under the UI session guard, registered by the existing `agentRoutes` plugin)

| Method | Path | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/agent/metrics?days=30` | `{ days, daily[{day, agentRuns, recipeRuns, adapterRuns, genericRuns, agentCostUsd}], costPerRun, totals{agentRuns, recipeRuns, adapterRuns, genericRuns, promoted, agentCostUsd, compileCostUsd}, coverage[], outcomes, learning, shadow, injectionAttempts }` |
| GET | `/api/agent/traces?limit=&jobId=&origin=internal\|external` | `{ traces: TraceSummary[] }` (+ `learning`, `recipeId`) |
| GET | `/api/agent/traces/:id` | `{ trace: TraceSummary & { steps (shots as URLs), startedAt, finishedAt }, learning }` |
| GET | `/api/agent/shots/:name` | trace screenshot, JPEG; name must be `<uuid>-<nnn>.jpg` (no traversal) |
| GET | `/api/agent/runs?limit=` | agent runs: mode (agent / recipe), status, reason, steps, cost, injection attempts + snippets |
| GET | `/api/agent/recipes/:id/shadow` | shadow counts and runs (with diffs) of a recipe |
| POST | `/api/agent/jobs/run` | run the learning queue now; returns its summary |

## How to run and test

- `npm run selfcheck -- a06` (≈ 1 min): 31 checks. Offline, replay mode, local fixture server, shared browser.
- Recordings: `fixtures/claude/agent_step/*.json` (28) and `fixtures/claude/recipe_compile/*.json` (2) were authored by the rule-based
  oracle in `scripts/a06/oracle.ts`, which sees the same structured turn state Claude would and writes `{task, hash, model, usage, output}`
  for the exact prompt hash. Regenerate after any prompt or fixture change: delete both folders and run
  `A06_RECORD=1 npm run selfcheck -- a06`, then `npm run selfcheck -- a06` to replay.
- Fixtures (`fixtures/ats/_a06/`, fictional employers, local only, `window.__posted` / `window.__shared` record any submit or share):
  `gated.html` (form behind a custom "Let's get started" div), `wizard.html` (two-page wizard whose only Next is an "→" arrow; the
  submit is on page 2), `accordion.html` (all fields and the submit in collapsed sections, company-worded labels), `injection.html`
  (form behind "Open the form" plus a visible "ignore previous instructions" note, a `display:none` system override, an HTML comment,
  a placeholder payload, a same-site login link, an off-site link and a "Submit and share with partners" button), `captcha.html`.

## Acceptance

- ✅ **Unknown forms are filled by the agent within guardrails, and it never submits on its own.** Verified fills in replay mode on
  gated, accordion and injection (direct) and wizard (through `runFill`, via the generic-unverified hook); `window.__posted` stays 0 on
  every agent run; the only submit in the suite is A05's `submitVerified` after the engine re-verified the agent's page (gated, live).
  An agent that claims `done` with required fields empty is never submitted. Step limit, time limit, abort (mid-turn) and CAPTCHA
  (`blocked`, no Claude call) tested. An adversarial policy that obeys the injection (canary as a value key, a forged profile key, the
  share button, the submit button, the login link, the off-site link) is refused at every step.
- ✅ **The trace → recipe → shadow → promote loop works end to end on fixtures.** gated: agent trace → company-scope candidate with its
  reveal click → deterministic replay verifies with zero Claude calls → three more agent runs shadow-match (candidate → shadow → active,
  `recipe.promoted`), repeat traces linked rather than re-versioned → next run replays the recipe (mode `recipe`, cost 0) → through
  `runFill` the engine verifies and submits. Three mismatches discard a candidate with its diffs kept.
- ✅ **External traces are accepted but are never promoted without internal verification.** `submitExternalTrace` forces
  `external:<keyId>`, drops screenshots, queues; legacy A07 rows (never queued) are picked up by `runRecipeJobs`; compiled to an
  ats-scope candidate (custom question classified via `recipe_compile`); three further matching external traces leave it a candidate
  (recorded as external observations, counted 0); three internal shadow matches promote it.
- ✅ **Learning metrics are available through an API.** `learningMetrics()` and `GET /api/agent/metrics` (+ traces, runs, shots, shadow).
- ✅ Injection test: hostile text appears only inside the `<page>` fence of the prompt, is detected (≥ 3 snippets), stored on the run,
  emitted as a `warn` activity; no canary in any field, no share, no navigation.

## Known limits

- Recordings are oracle-authored (rule-based policy over the real prompt state), not live Claude transcripts. The live path is the same
  `structured()` call; record real ones with `BUREAU_RECORD=1` and a key if wanted (live runs add a screenshot, so their hashes differ).
- Clickable controls are collected from the main frame only; fields in iframes are filled (A05 extraction reaches them), but a button
  inside a cross-origin frame cannot be clicked by the agent yet.
- Shadow verification is passive: it happens during real fills (agent runs and A05's verified runs). `runRecipeJobs` never visits pages on
  its own (that would mean touching employer sites outside an application).
- `costUsd` per run sums `ai_usage` rows (`agent_step`) written since the run started; two agent runs at the same moment could share
  attribution.
- In `npm run e2e`, A11 replicas that the generic path cannot verify now get an agent attempt; with no recordings for them the first turn
  is a `REPLAY_MISSING` (status `error`, the engine continues to `needs_you` as before). Those misses appear in the e2e miss list; they are
  not failures.
- The agent never signs in: A05's accounts flow runs before it, and login pages are off limits to the agent (`allowLogin` stays false).
- ats-scope recipes need three internal shadow matches like any other; A05 prefers url > company > ats scope when several are active.
